quote: The Pierce–Birkhoff conjecture was first stated, albeit in non-rigorous and vague wording, in the 1956 paper of Garrett Birkhoff and Richard S. Pierce in which they first introduced f-rings.
posed_by: Garrett Birkhoff and Richard S. Pierce
note: Stated in non-rigorous wording in the original 1956 paper; rigorous modern formulation developed later by Henriksen and Isbell in the early 1960s
